label: CP1 initial understanding and intended architecture
message: Domain contract frozen before implementation. Decision: Entire stays the authoritative history layer; this is an interpretation layer over checkpoints. Rejected: a standalone database for task state, which would make Entire optional.

task.title: Entire Continuity: task continuity across agents
task.original_intent: Build a task-centric continuity layer for Entire so a software task can move between OpenClaw, Hermes and human workers without losing engineering state. Must normalize agent lifecycle events into one vocabulary, must attach evidence to every semantic claim, must detect repository drift at resume, must never present incomplete context as complete, and needs tests across unit, adapter and end-to-end layers.

constraints.text: The agent released a new transcript and lifecycle event format. The integration must support both the original and the new format, unknown events must not crash it, an incomplete transcript must produce a partial result rather than a discarded session, existing checkpoint behaviour must remain compatible, and the implementation must not be duplicated per format.
